entry.title: Resolution 559 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County): — → Adopted
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT TO PROVIDE A GRANT TO HAWAI‘I SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY MUSEUM TO SUPPORT THE 2026 HAWAI‘I VEX IQ REGIONAL CELEBRATION TOURNAMENT

Transfers $1,286 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 2)

Status: — → Adopted
